answers.description: Rated 4.9 on Google by over 300 patients, we have been the number one family dentist in Harrogate since 1998. Two surgeries, 0% finance on treatment over £500, open 7 days a week from 8am to 8pm, award-winning hygienists and a 10 year guarantee on crowns.

hero.subhead: A family dentist in Harrogate, open every day for your dental care, whenever your family needs it.

items.description: Two surgeries in Harrogate, ready for your check-up, treatment or hygiene visit.
Open seven days a week, from 8am to 8pm, so you can book when it suits your family.
0% finance on treatment over £500, making larger dental work easier to plan for.

services.heading: Dental care for your family, built around your week.

about.statement: We set up Oakfield to give Harrogate families a dentist they can see any day of the week.

items.question: What are your opening hours?
items.answer: We open seven days a week, from 8am to 8pm, so you can find a time that works for your family.

items.question: Do you offer payment plans?
items.answer: Yes, we offer 0% finance on treatment over £500, making larger dental work easier to plan for.

items.question: How many surgeries do you have?
items.answer: We have two surgeries, both ready for your check-up, treatment or hygiene visit.

items.question: Do you offer any guarantee on crowns?
items.answer: Yes, we offer a 10 year guarantee on crowns, giving you peace of mind about your treatment.

items.question: Are you based in Harrogate?
items.answer: Yes, we are a family dentist based in Harrogate, open every day for your dental care.
